text: As I find myself here, gazing through the glass into a vibrant, modern space dedicated to research and development, I am struck by the tension between the sterile order of the corridor and the creative energy beyond the barrier. The presence of safety equipment—fire extinguisher and hose—reminds me of an underlying fragility, even as innovation is celebrated just out of arm's reach. There is anticipation, a quiet desire to cross thresholds both literal and metaphorical.
